defects.title: Tabular Preprocessing Data Leakage Across Splits
defects.root_cause: _prepare_data fitted OneHotEncoder and column schemas on entire dataset X prior to train/val/holdout partitioning, leaking category vocabularies and distributions.
defects.remediation: Engineered standalone TabularPreprocessor in src/amde/preprocessing/tabular.py. Split raw data X before transformer fitting, fitting preprocessor strictly on X_train_raw.

defects.title: Holdout Test Split Exposure and Implicit In-Fit Evaluation
defects.root_cause: Holdout test data was exposed via public property holdout_data_ and automatically evaluated inside fit(), enabling adaptive leakage.
defects.remediation: Sealed holdout into private _holdout_data_. Gated evaluation behind explicit evaluate_holdout() single-use cryptographic seal.

defects.title: Pareto & Elite Archive Contamination by Failed Candidates
defects.root_cause: Evaluations with status != 'completed', NaNs, non-finite loss/latency/memory or 0.0 latency sentinels were inserted into archives, falsely dominating valid models.
defects.remediation: Enforced strict validation in ParetoArchive.update and EliteArchive.add (loss/latency/memory finite and strictly positive). Routed failed candidates to AMDE4Engine.failure_history.

defects.title: Dynamic Stacking Selection Bias and Meta-Feature In-Sample Contamination
defects.root_cause: Validation set X_val was used both for candidate selection and meta-learner training, causing optimistic bias in Super Learner weights.
defects.remediation: Implemented genuine K-Fold Out-Of-Fold (OOF) cross-validation predictions on fit_X to train L2 LogisticRegression meta-learner.

defects.title: EventLedger Background Writer Concurrency Race & Silent Failure
defects.root_cause: Queue put occurred outside mutex lock leading to out-of-order SQLite sequence writes; worker exceptions were swallowed silently.
defects.remediation: Synchronized queue put within _lock. Captured worker exception in _writer_exception and re-raised on flush().

defects.title: Scikit-Learn BaseEstimator Cloning Contract & Alias Mutation
defects.root_cause: __init__ modified arguments in-place, violating Scikit-Learn BaseEstimator contract and get_params() roundtrip.
defects.remediation: Preserved all __init__ parameters verbatim as instance attributes; computed effective parameters dynamically during fit().

defects.title: Predict Proba Non-Finite & Unnormalized Output Risk
defects.root_cause: DynamicStackingEnsemble predict_proba could emit unnormalized or non-finite values if base models produced divergent logits.
defects.remediation: Implemented robust probability normalization, clipping, and dimension alignment with classes_.

defects.title: Publish to PyPI CI Cancellation Due to Unconstrained Thread Oversubscription
defects.root_cause: GitHub Actions 2-core runner hung for 23 minutes on unconstrained OpenMP/BLAS threads during test execution.
defects.remediation: Exported OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 and switched runner invocation to scripts/run_unit_tests.py.
defects.verification_test: Local unit suite execution within bounds
